_about: The Smithy (coding worker) settings. Edit in Notepad++, then close and reopen The Smithy. It runs on the CPU only and independently of voice Othos and of Firestarter (they take turns on the CPU when both have work).
_backend: Which program runs the Smithy's model: "ollama" or "llama-server" (llama.cpp, or ik_llama.cpp). The model switcher in The Smithy app changes the model below.
_llama_server: Only used when backend is llama-server. exe = path to llama-server.exe; models_dir = folder of .gguf files. Started with -ngl 0 and the graphics card hidden. Port 11438 (Firestarter's llama-server uses 11437).
_ollama: A small PC (this laptop, 16 GB RAM): the shared Ollama on 11434. A bigger PC (the new build: 12-core CPU, 128 GB RAM; The Smithy still runs on the CPU only): set start_own to true; The Smithy then runs its own Ollama on port 11436 with the graphics card hidden from it (CPU only).
_models: qwen2.5-coder:3b is the stand-in for a small PC (this laptop, 16 GB RAM). On a bigger PC (the new build: 12-core CPU, 128 GB RAM; The Smithy still runs on the CPU only): code = Qwen3-Coder 30B-A3B (name as in ollama list).
_threads: CPU threads per task. The Smithy and Firestarter take turns (never side by side), so each gets all of these. Small PC (this laptop): 4, leaving the rest for voice Othos. Bigger PC (the new build, 12 cores): about 10.
_gaming: While a game from gaming.json runs (or gaming mode is turned on by hand). pause = stop and requeue the task; throttle = keep going, held back.
_context_tokens: How much the model can read at once. Small PC (this laptop): 8192. Bigger PC (the new build): 32768 (builds see more of the files already written).
_max_build_minutes: Builds from scratch write several files, so they get longer.
_max_build_files: The most files one build may plan (the README is extra).
_code_folders: Folders the review, fix and Joomla tasks may read files from; private files inside them stay blocked (worker_files.py). Relative paths start from this folder; missing ones are skipped (../ui is the shared copy's layout).
_cloud: Other model providers by API key (worker_cloud.py). OFF until a provider is listed in enabled AND its key is in .env (never here). A task uses the local model unless it names a provider ('using DeepSeek', or --provider NAME) or default is set. Local first: lmstudio is LM Studio's server on this PC. Cloud: anthropic, openrouter, deepseek, mistral, nvidia, gemini, groq, cerebras, together, fireworks, openai, huggingface; freellmapi runs on this PC but forwards to free cloud tiers (treated as cloud). Keys in .env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY, NVIDIA_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, CEREBRAS_API_KEY, TOGETHER_API_KEY, FIREWORKS_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, HF_TOKEN, FREELLMAPI_KEY (from its dashboard).
_cloud_safety: accept_data_use: providers whose free tier may train on what's sent (gemini, openrouter :free models, freellmapi) are refused unless listed here. Limits: tokens per task and per day; prices (dollars per million tokens, [input, output]) turn on max_usd_per_day. Today's use: state\cloud-usage.json.
